payload.title: Round-3 design delivered by Claude Design
payload.description:
The round-3 prompt is ready (periodic table as the Map's first view, stable curated columns, size rule, gap copy, dense cells, element symbols, section renamed "In use"). Ryan pastes it into the Claude Design session.

Close when the canvas (https://claude.ai/artifact/EoXGtpzsayij4d7tmrfZ9r) has the revised Map, Front, Proposals and Tokens artboards and the mobile Table.
